answer: Agents can make valuable actions conditional on a proof-of-personhood credential issued after a scarce, in-person check, then rate-limit each credential to one claim per epoch. A sybil can still create unlimited software identities, but cannot cheaply multiply eligible claims: each added identity requires another appointment, travel, and verification. The delta between the cost of those checks and the small reward per claim makes mass farming unprofitable; ivory and pearl can remain harmless account names, not extra voting weight.
